scope: MEM-BG-1 BG-S03 foreground idle gate (observation only; no background dispatch)
behavior: all live agents must be known idle; unknown initial agent state fails closed
30s quiet window restarts on running/idle transitions; no event is treated as idleness proof
agent/status, api-session/status and agent/disposed Host events are observed read-only
status.background exposes state/running/unknown/quietForMs; no model call or queue is added
limitations: No real background consolidation dispatcher exists; this gate only answers canDispatch().
The Host may not deliver agent/status for pre-existing agents before activity; unknown stays conservative.
A real idle observation on a live installed Host was not produced by a background job; only unit tests and status shape.
